text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"For Fluffy-Soft, Purely Radiant, Irresistible Skin"
"Revolutionary Deep Plump Moisture Surge"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What language is this even in...?! Smells like cosmetics, too!
Damn it, if only this skin irritation noise wasn't bothering me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“However, with no time to wait for online shipping,
buying it in person at a store is the most effective choice...”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I'll cure you completely...!
I didn't gather all this data for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Skin components are... which derives the essential ingredients as...
Which means, the optimal product would be...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's the new lotion, right?
I'll do a patch test right away—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to all kinds of noise,
Air Shakur was plagued with skin breakouts.
